# Inferlo

> Inferlo is an enterprise-ready, batteries-included TypeScript backend framework (routes, schemas, database with PostgreSQL and migrations, auth, rate limiting, background jobs, cron, OpenAPI) with AI models built in (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama and OpenAI-compatible providers with fallback, structured output, streaming, tool calling, embeddings and usage tracking) and an MCP server, with zero runtime dependencies. Runs on Node.js 22.18+, Bun, Deno and edge runtimes. Package: @browserlessapi/inferlo.

Key rules: routes are private unless `auth: "public"`; validate input with `t.*` schemas; use `db.<table>` methods (never string-built SQL); every model has id, createdAt, updatedAt automatically; relative imports end in `.ts`; run `inferlo describe --json` to see an app and `inferlo check --json` after changes.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): install, project layout, minimal app
- [Configuration](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/config.md): config({ schema, secrets, environments }), typed settings validated at startup, secrets redacted
- [Schemas](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/schema.md): t.* types, modifiers, validation, JSON Schema
- [Models and database](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/database.md): model(), queries, adapters, db push, transactions
- [Routes](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/routes.md): options, handler context, return values, errors, middleware, deprecated routes (Deprecation and Sunset headers), API versions with apiVersion("v1", routes) and an OpenAPI document per version
- [WebSockets](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/websockets.md): route.ws(path, { message, auth, rateLimit }).handle(fn) with the same auth, permissions and rate limits as HTTP routes, JSON messages validated and handled in order, ctx.socket, origin checks, on Node.js, Bun and Deno
- [Auth](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/auth.md): auth.resolve, roles, permissions() with can() and authorize() and the route permission option, bearer API keys, passwords
- [AI](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/ai.md): providers, aliases and fallback, structured output, streaming, embeddings, usage and budgets
- [Modules](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/modules.md): module("billing", { imports, models, routes, jobs, provides }) splits a large app into feature modules with explicit dependencies, createApp({ modules }), checked at startup and shown in describe
- [MCP, OpenAPI and describe](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/mcp.md)
- [GraphQL](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/graphql.md): graphqlRoute({ query, mutation }) from @browserlessapi/inferlo/graphql serves the app's routes as GraphQL fields with their auth, permissions, validation and rate limits, types from response schemas, maxFields and introspection limits, graphqlSchema() for client code generation
- [CLI](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/cli.md)
- [Testing](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/testing.md)
- [Use with other frameworks](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/integrations.md): the AI module in any framework, toNodeHandler and fromNodeRequest to mount an app in Express, Fastify, NestJS or node:http (fallthrough: true passes unmatched requests to the host), inferloAI() middleware for Hono (c.var.ai), Express (req.ai), Koa (ctx.ai), Elysia (ai) and tRPC (ctx.ai), toKoaMiddleware() to mount an app in Koa, inferloPlugin for Fastify (request.ai, app under a prefix), InferloModule for NestJS, an AdonisJS provider (ctx.ai, config/ai.ts), InferloAI and inferloAI() for Ts.ED injection, trpcTools() for tRPC procedures as AI tools, toNextHandlers() for Next.js App Router route handlers, an Encore.ts raw endpoint serving the app with toNodeHandler(app, { prefix }) and createAI in Encore services
- [Migrate from Express](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/migrate-from-express.md): move an Express app to Inferlo route by route at the same URLs, with a concept mapping table, shared auth and tests
- [Migrate from NestJS](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/migrate-from-nestjs.md): move a NestJS app to Inferlo route by route at the same URLs with toNodeHandler(app, { fallthrough: true }), Nest modules, providers, guards, pipes and DTOs mapped to Inferlo modules, plain functions, auth and schemas
- [Migrate from Hono](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/migrate-from-hono.md): move a Hono app to Inferlo route by route at the same URLs with hono.all("*", (c) => inferlo.fetch(c.req.raw)), Hono validators, middleware, sub-apps and basePath mapped to Inferlo schemas, createApp options, modules and apiVersion
- [Migrate from Koa](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/migrate-from-koa.md): move a Koa app to Inferlo route by route at the same URLs with toKoaMiddleware(app, { fallthrough: true }) before the Koa router, @koa/router routes, ctx.throw, body parsers and Koa middleware mapped to Inferlo routes, schemas, errors and createApp options
- [Security](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/security.md): secure defaults and security headers (createApp({ secureHeaders }))
- [Observability](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/observability.md): request ids (X-Request-Id, ctx.requestId), request logs and JSON logs with createApp({ logging: { format: "json", requests: true } }), your own logger, Prometheus metrics with createApp({ metrics: { token } })
- [Deployment](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/deploy.md): Node, Bun, Deno, edge, health and readiness endpoints, graceful shutdown with app.close()
- [Performance](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/performance.md): reproducible throughput and latency benchmark against Fastify, Hono, Express and NestJS (npm run bench:perf) and the latest results
- [Support policy](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/support.md): semantic versioning, which versions get fixes, LTS after 1.0, deprecation rules and supported runtime, database and framework versions
- [Error codes](https://github.com/BrowserlessAPI/Inferlo/blob/main/docs/errors.md): every ILxxxx code with its fix
